start.text: Day four. The ransomware is gone, the files are back, and the office is calm. A calm office is never a good sign.
start.name: Joshua

B.text: IT desk, this is Joshua. How can I help?
B.name: Joshua

C.text: Joshua? It's Nadia Costa, from HR. Victor Lang leaves on Friday, and the access system says he opened the salary folder last night. Sales has no business in there.
C.name: Nadia

D1.text: I... I don't know. He has been here for six years. I would hate to think so.
D1.name: Nadia

D2.text: Find out what happened, please. But do not confront him. Not yet. I want to speak with him myself.
D2.name: Nadia

E.text: We do not know yet. His sign-in is real, so I need evidence of what he did, and I will not guess why.
E.name: Joshua

F.text: Thank you. Please be careful with him.
F.name: Nadia

G.text: Every file opened and every file sent leaves a record. And if I need an answer from HR, I can always ask.
G.name: Joshua

H.text: [b][color=green]4 clues[/color][/b] should be enough to show what he did. Then I sort what I know from what I do not.
H.name: Joshua
